name: Tensor Title
description: Shared DOM header pattern for the title strip above matrix and volume tensor visualizations. It renders tensor identity, logical/physical/tile shape, dtype, format, memory, owner, partition, state, provenance, step, axes, constraints, and a live status in a token-based header without adding product chrome or business rules.
useWhen: placing a title strip directly above a tensor, matrix, volume, or tile visualization
showing the same tensor identity and metadata language across matrix-canvas, tensor-volume-canvas, and tiling viewports
linking a tensor header to selection, playback, tiling, memory, and provenance state
keeping logical shape, physical layout, memory placement, tile partition, and state separate instead of concatenating them into one string

sceneContract.label: required string: primary tensor variable or object name
sceneContract.role: optional enum: input, output, weight, bias, scratch, temp, reduction, fusion, broadcast, aggregate
sceneContract.logicalShape: optional string or { label, dims }: user-facing logical shape, for example NCHW [1,4,16,16]
sceneContract.physicalShape: optional string or { label, dims }: physical layout shape, for example NC1HWC0 [1,1,16,16,16]
sceneContract.tileShape: optional string or { label, dims }: current tile shape, for example base tile [128,64]
sceneContract.dtype: optional string: dtype or dtype chain, for example half → float → half
sceneContract.format: optional string: format/layout identifier, for example NCHW, NC1HWC0, A1, A2, NZ, ZN, ND
sceneContract.axes: optional string[]: axis labels, for example ['N', 'M', 'K']
sceneContract.memory: optional object { tier, sizeBytes, offset, range, stride, alignment }: memory placement and address facts
sceneContract.owner: optional string: queue, allocator, or owning object, for example inQueueX
sceneContract.queueDepth: optional positive integer: queue slot depth when owner is a queue
sceneContract.partition: optional object { blockCount, blockLength, tileLength, blockIndex, tileIndex, tileRange }: block/core and tile partition facts
sceneContract.state: optional enum: alloc, loading, loaded, enqueued, computing, accumulated, produced, ready, current, selected, written, free, skipped
sceneContract.direction: optional string: data movement direction, for example GM → UB or L1 → L0A
sceneContract.provenance: optional object { symbol, file, line, evidence }: source code and evidence linkage
sceneContract.step: optional object { phase, operationChips, stepIndex, totalSteps }: playback/step linkage
sceneContract.constraints: optional string[]: constraints and notes such as 32B aligned, no tail, padding, broadcast, dynamic shape
sceneContract.status: optional string: right-aligned live status, for example block 0 · tile 1/16

requiredApis: window.PtoTensorTitle.render(host, scene, options) returning { update, destroy }
allowedOverrides: scene.label, role, shapes, dtype, format, axes, memory, owner, queueDepth, partition, state, direction, provenance, step, constraints, and status
host container dimensions and aria label
header density and which field groups are visible
placement of the header host above a canvas or visualization
forbiddenOverrides: copying or rewriting the header layout, field normalization, byte formatting, or escape logic in a consuming page
overriding the shared token palette or replacing semantic tokens with page-local colors
deriving shapes, format, memory placement, state, or tiling facts inside the Pattern; business pages supply these facts
adding product-specific pane, card, toolbar, inspector, or playback chrome inside the header renderer
wrapping the header in a second bordered card or page-private header band
embedding this Pattern through an iframe in consuming pages

typography.dataVizFallback: Every header field is readable text; compact density hides only secondary rows, never the primary label.

behavior: the primary line shows label, optional role, and optional direction
the meta line shows logical, physical, and tile shapes plus dtype and format
chips show memory tier and size, owner and queue depth, partition, state, and operation chips
the footer shows constraints and provenance when available
the right side shows status or step summary when available
compact density hides the footer and collapses chip rows while preserving the primary label
all text is inserted as text content, not HTML strings
controller.update re-renders the header in place without leaving stale nodes
controller.destroy clears the header and removes pattern state from the host
agentReuseRule: Load patterns/tensor-title/pattern.css and pattern.js, then call window.PtoTensorTitle.render(host, scene, options). Keep logical shape, physical shape, tile shape, format, memory, owner, partition, state, provenance, step, and constraints as structured fields supplied by the business page. Do not copy the header DOM/CSS, add a card shell, recolor with page-local values, or move tensor semantics into the Pattern.
